raw_comment:
The first thing that I noticed when looking at this graph was that the majority of the country is in some level of a drought. This drought is not limited to the south, north, or any of the coasts; it is completely widespread.

I wonder what about this year made the country go into such a widespread drought, and if this could have been prevented beforehand with the technology, we have access to. 

This relates to my community because according to the graph my area is experiencing a moderate drought, and this may affect our ability to use water appliances and access to clean drinking water. 

A catchy headline for this graph would be: "Where is the US suffering the worst droughts?"
